scope: Hand-written api tables in apps/docs/src/content/*/meta.ts against props types resolved by the TypeScript checker. Names only: types and defaults written in the tables are not compared.

rules.own: A property is own when at least one declaration is inside packages/ui/src; others are only counted.
rules.mergedNames: "a / b / c" names several properties; a merged part entry "A / B" is one table for a group of exports, so a property is documented if any table of the group names it and exists if any part of the group has it.
rules.generic: native props, ARIA, events, 原生属性, XProps and similar phrases stand for the inherited remainder and are not claims about a property.
rules.union: Props that are a union (Calendar mode) contribute the properties of every member.

gate: documented-but-missing and unresolved must not exceed docs/api-drift.baseline.json; undocumented is report-only.
